cases.note: A gws edit made by another client leaves this workspace's cached render behind it: bounded serves the old bytes for its ttl, and fresh finds each file's Drive modifiedTime moved and renders again. The edit runs on the shadow workspace because a gws write on the read side drops that side's caches itself. The target mounts only the three apps because a workspace-wide fresh refuses a RAM mount.
